entries.name: alias
entries.description:
Used to create a reference to a command or list of commands.
When used without parameters, displays all current aliases.. Enclose multiple commands within quotes and separate each command with a semi-colon.

entries.name: allskins
entries.description:
Downloads all skins that is currently in use.
Useful for refreshing skins without exiting the level.

entries.name: +attack
entries.description:
When active the player will fire the weapon he is currently holding.
This is the primary command used to make the player fire the gun.
For as long as the key that is bound to this command is held down and this command is active the player will keep on firing the gun.

entries.name: -attack
entries.description: When used the player will stop firing the gun if "+attack" is active.

entries.name: +back
entries.description: When active the player will move backwards.

entries.name: -back
entries.description: When used the player will stop moving back if "+back" is active.

entries.name: bf
entries.description:
This command shows a background screen flash that is the same one that is produced when the player picked up an item in the game.
This command basically serves no useful function except when people want to use it in scripts to give the user some visual feedback when an aliases is used for example.

entries.name: bind
entries.description:
This command binds one or several commands to a key.
To bind multiple commands to a key, enclose the commands in double-quotes (") and separate them with semicolons (;).

entries.name: cd
entries.description: cd play 5 plays cd track #5. You need -cdaudio to use this command.

entries.name: centerview
entries.description: Centers the player's view ahead after +lookup or +lookdown.

entries.name: changing
entries.description: Internal command the server sends to tell the client a level change is underway; the client clears its state and prepares to reconnect to the new map.

entries.name: clear
entries.description: This command clears the console screen of any text.

entries.name: cmd
entries.description: Sends a command directly to the server.

entries.name: color
entries.description: This command sets the color for the player's shirt and pants.. If only the shirt color is given, the pant color will match.

entries.name: connect
entries.description: Connects your client to a QuakeWorld server.

entries.name: disconnect
entries.description: This command will disconnect you from the server/demo/proxy you are currently connected to.

entries.name: download
entries.description:
Manually download a quake file from the server.

Example:
download skins/foo.pcx

entries.name: echo
entries.description: This command will print text to your local console.

entries.name: envmap
entries.description: Captures six screenshots from the current viewpoint, one per cardinal direction, forming an environment (cube) map -- a content/development tool.

entries.name: exec
entries.description: Executes a config file from \qw, \id1 or \ezquake. The companion command `serverexec` runs the same script routed to the server command buffer (`cbuf_server`) instead of the main client buffer -- useful for sending commands that should execute on the server side in listen-server builds.

entries.name: flush
entries.description:
This command will clear the current game cache.
It is usually used by developers to flush the memory of all game information and objects to test if the mechanism which handles the loading of the necessary files into memory works properly.
Sometimes the game cache can become filled with unnecessary information and may need to be flushed manually. This is usually not necessary since the game automatically flushes all the data between every map.

entries.name: force_centerview
entries.description:
This command centers the player's screen.
It was created because the original "centerview" command did not work when "+mlook" was enabled.
This command will center the screen in any mode no matter commands are active.

entries.name: +forward
entries.description: When active the player will move forward.

entries.name: -forward
entries.description: When used the player will stop moving forward if "+forward" is active.

entries.name: fullinfo
entries.description:
Used by QuakeSpy and Qlist to set setinfo variables.

Example:
fullinfo "\quote\I am the only Lamer!\". Use the setinfo command to see the output.

entries.name: fullserverinfo
entries.description: Internal command carrying the server's complete serverinfo string to the client; sent by the server, not typed by users.

entries.name: gl_texturemode
entries.description: Sets the OpenGL texture filtering mode (for example GL_LINEAR or GL_NEAREST), controlling whether textures look smoothed or pixelated; with no argument it prints the current mode.

entries.name: help
entries.description: Enters manual pages. Use arrows, [Page Down], [Page Up], [Tab] and [Enter] for navigation.

entries.name: impulse
entries.description:
This command calls a game function or QuakeC function.
Often impulses are used by the mod by defining aliases for game functions like "ready" and "break" that call certain impulses.

entries.name: joyadvancedupdate
entries.description: This command must be run to apply changes made to the joyadvaxis[xyzruv] or joyindex cvars.

entries.name: +jump
entries.description: When active the player will do a single jump. The next jump won't be performed until "-jump" has been issued.

entries.name: -jump
entries.description: When used the player will stop jumping if "+jump" is active.

entries.name: kill
entries.description: Suicide. (-2 frags on ktpro/kteam servers)

entries.name: +klook
entries.description:
When active, "+forward" and "+back" become "+lookup" and "+lookdown"  respectively.
This command is useful if the player needs to look at objects which are above or below him.

entries.name: -klook
entries.description: When used the forward and back keys will stop making the player look up and down if "+klook" is active.

entries.name: +left
entries.description: When active the player will turn left.

entries.name: -left
entries.description: When used the player will stop turning left if "+left" is active.

entries.name: +lookdown
entries.description: When active the player will look down.

entries.name: -lookdown
entries.description: When used the player will stop looking down if "+lookdown" is active.

entries.name: +lookup
entries.description: When active the player will look up.

entries.name: -lookup
entries.description: When used the player will stop looking up if "+lookup" is active.

entries.name: menu_keys
entries.description: This command will display the keys menu.

entries.name: menu_main
entries.description: This command will display the main menu.

entries.name: menu_options
entries.description: This command will display the options menu.

entries.name: menu_quit
entries.description: This command will display the quit menu.

entries.name: menu_video
entries.description: This command will display the video menu.

entries.name: messagemode
entries.description: Prompts for string to broadcast to all other players.

entries.name: messagemode2
entries.description: Prompts for string to broadcast to team members.

entries.name: +mlook
entries.description:
When active moving the mouse or joystick forwards and backwards performs "+lookup" and "+lookdown" respectively.
This command is very useful if the player needs to look at objects which are above or below him.
Most players execute this command and never remove it. This way they can use the keyboard to move the player forward and back and strafe left and right, while using the mouse to turn the player left and right and to make him look up and down.
In order to have this command set permanently you will have to create a file called autoexec.cfg in the qw/ directory and put in the line "+mlook" into that file.
By doing this the game will automatically execute the autoexec.cfg file and it will also active that command.
Almost every player uses this command nowadays, because the combination of using mouse and keyboard is widely considered the best.

entries.name: -mlook
entries.description: When used the mouse forward and back movement will stop making the player look up and down if "+mlook" is active.

entries.name: +movedown
entries.description: When active the player will swim down when in the water.

entries.name: -movedown
entries.description: When used the player will stop moving down if "+movedown" is active.

entries.name: +moveleft
entries.description: When active the player will strafe left.

entries.name: -moveleft
entries.description: When used the player will stop moving left if "+moveleft" is active.

entries.name: +moveright
entries.description: When active the player will strafe right.

entries.name: -moveright
entries.description: When used the player will stop moving right if "+moveright" is active.

entries.name: +moveup
entries.description: When active the player will swim up when in the water.

entries.name: -moveup
entries.description: When used the player will stop moving up if "+moveup" is active.

entries.name: nextul
entries.description: Internal command that sends the next block of an in-progress client file upload.

entries.name: packet
entries.description:
Sends a packet with specified contents to the destination.

Example:
packet 123.123.123.123:27500 "status"

entries.name: path
entries.description: Shows what paths ezQuake is using.

entries.name: pause
entries.description: Pauses a game.. Servers must support pausing.

entries.name: play
entries.description:
Plays a sound effect.

Example:
play misc/runekey.wav

entries.name: playdemo
entries.description:
Plays a recorded demo.

Example:
playdemo thresh.qwd

entries.name: playvol
entries.description:
Plays a sound at a given volume.

Examples:
playvol items/protect.wav .5
playvol items/protect.wav 2

entries.name: pointfile
entries.description: If qbsp generates a non-zero .pts file a leak exists in the level. This file is created in the maps directory. By using the pointfile command, it will load the .pts file and give a dotted line indicating where the leak(s) are on the level.

entries.name: quit
entries.description: Exit - disconnects from the server and closes the client.

entries.name: rcon
entries.description:
Issue the set of commands to the server you are currently connected to or have set in rcon_address.
You must know the rcon password for that specific server.

entries.name: reconnect
entries.description: Reconnects to the last server/proxy.

entries.name: record
entries.description:
Records a demo.

Example:
record test
 - records test.qwd to qw folder

The companion command `recordqwd` bypasses the listen-server routing branch and always records a client-side QWD; use `recordqwd` when the listen-server form of `record` would route the recording to the server-side MVD command instead.

entries.name: rerecord
entries.description: Restarts demo recording on the current connection, beginning a fresh demo without disconnecting.

entries.name: +right
entries.description: When active the player will turn right.

entries.name: -right
entries.description: When used the player will stop turning right if "+right" is active.

entries.name: say
entries.description:
Broadcasts a string to all other players.

Example:
say ezQuake rules!

entries.name: say_team
entries.description:
Broadcasts a string to teammates.

Example:
say_team stop boring!

entries.name: screenshot
entries.description: Saves a still picture of current screen to your hard drive.

entries.name: serverinfo
entries.description: Reports the current server info.

entries.name: setinfo
entries.description:
Sets information about your FuhWorld user.
Used without a key it will list all of your current settings. Specifying a non-existent key and a value will create the new key.

entries.name: +showscores
entries.description: Display scoreboard.

entries.name: -showscores
entries.description: When used the score screen will disappear if +showscores is active.

entries.name: +showteamscores
entries.description: Display team scoreboard.

entries.name: -showteamscores
entries.description: When used the score screen will disappear if +showteamscores is active.

entries.name: sizedown
entries.description: Reduces the screen size.

entries.name: sizeup
entries.description: Increases the screen size.

entries.name: skins
entries.description: Refreshes skin settings.. If you have set noskins to 0 and do this it will download all skins that players are using on server.

entries.name: snap
entries.description:
Remote screenshot from a player.

Example:
snap 1234
 - server requests remote screenshot from user 1234

entries.name: soundinfo
entries.description: Reports information on the sound system.

entries.name: soundlist
entries.description: Reports a list of sounds in the cache.

entries.name: +speed
entries.description: When active the player will run.

entries.name: -speed
entries.description: When used the player will walk.

entries.name: stop
entries.description: Stops demo recording. The companion command `stopqwd` bypasses the listen-server routing branch in `CL_Stop_f` and always stops client-side QWD recording, whereas `stop` routes to the server-side MVD stop command in a listen-server build.

entries.name: stopsound
entries.description: Stops all sounds currently being played.

entries.name: stopul
entries.description: Stops an in-progress client file upload.

entries.name: +strafe
entries.description: When active, "+left" and "+right" function like "+moveleft" and "+moveright", strafing in that direction.

entries.name: -strafe
entries.description: When used the turn left and turn right keys will once again perform their original functions.

entries.name: stuffcmds
entries.description: Executes any '+' commands passed on the command line at startup (such as +connect or +map). Run once during initialization.

entries.name: timedemo
entries.description:
This command will load and play a demo at full speed. It will then divide the total number of frames in the demo by the total time it took finish, and calculate the average frames-per-second rate.

Example:
timedemo demoname

entries.name: timerefresh
entries.description: This command will perform a 360 degree turn and calculate the frames-per-second rate.

entries.name: togglechat
entries.description: Toggles the console chat input prompt on or off.

entries.name: toggleconsole
entries.description: Brings the console up and down.

entries.name: togglemenu
entries.description: Displays the menu screens.

entries.name: unbind
entries.description: Example: unbind x delete strings on x button.

entries.name: unbindall
entries.description: Removes all keyboard bindings.

entries.name: +use
entries.description: When used it will activate objects in the game that have been designed to react at "+use"

entries.name: -use
entries.description: When used it will stop activating objects in the game that have been designed to react at "+use".

entries.name: user
entries.description: This command queries the user for his setinfo information.

entries.name: users
entries.description: Reports information on connected players and retrieve user IDs.

entries.name: v_cshift
entries.description:
This adjusts all of the colors currently being displayed.
Used when you are underwater, hit, have the Ring of Shadows, or Quad Damage.

Example:
v_cshift 16 32 64

entries.name: version
entries.description: Prints client version number and date into the console.

entries.name: vid_debug
entries.description: SVGAlib-build developer command that prints video-mode debugging information.

entries.name: vid_describecurrentmode
entries.description: Prints the details -- resolution, color depth, refresh -- of the video mode currently in use.

entries.name: vid_describemode
entries.description: Prints the details of a video mode identified by its number.

entries.name: vid_describemodes
entries.description: Lists every available video mode with its details.

entries.name: vid_forcemode
entries.description: This command will force ezQuake to use a certain video mode.

entries.name: vid_fullscreen
entries.description: Switches the client into a fullscreen video mode.

entries.name: vid_minimize
entries.description:
This command will minimize the windowed game screen.
It was made available because the game takes control over the mouse when it is moved onto the game window thus prohibiting the normal minimization of the game window.

entries.name: vid_nummodes
entries.description: Prints the number of available video modes.

entries.name: vid_testmode
entries.description: This command will switch to the specified video mode for 5-seconds in order to test it.

entries.name: vid_windowed
entries.description: This command will switch the a windowed video mode specified in the "vid_windowed_mode" variable.

entries.name: wait
entries.description: Adds one wait frame.

entries.name: windows
entries.description: Switches away from client and back to the Windows OS.
